subject: Vendor security questionnaire kickoff — HIPAA/GDPR clarifications
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps on security questionnaire (HIPAA/GDPR)

Hi Jane / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Recap: Nimbus Health is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing clinical features (PHI in scope). You wanted confirmation on SOC 2 coverage, BAA approach, encryption key options, and a completed vendor questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ or your custom form).
- Next steps we propose: 1) We can accept either SIG or CAIQ — attaching a filled quick-template to speed things up; 2) I'll loop in our security lead (Vivek) and sales ops (Monica) for any follow-ups; 3) Please confirm whether Nimbus needs Redwood to sign a BAA or if you prefer a mutual template to start.

A few clarifying questions from our side to help complete the questionnaire correctly:
1) Is PHI considered "structured clinical data" only, or will PDFs and images of patient documents be stored/processed?
2) Do you require BYOK (customer-managed keys) for data at rest, or will Redwood-managed keys suffice if we provide audit logs and key rotation details?
3) Any specific data residency constraint (US-only / state-level restrictions) beyond standard US residency?
4) Target timeline for completing the SIG/CAIQ + contract signature?

I've attached a short SOC 2 summary and a CSV template we often pre-fill for SIG/CAIQ. If you prefer a DocuSign flow for the CAIQ/BAA, we'll follow that.

Thanks — happy to hop on a follow-up call if that helps.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf; redwood-sig-template.csv

From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@nimbushealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps on security questionnaire (HIPAA/GDPR)

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the recap. A few notes: 

- PHI scope: we anticipate both structured clinical data and document artifacts (PDFs), so both will be in-scope.
- BAA: Nimbus requires a signed BAA from vendors processing PHI. We'll send our standard BAA template; if Redwood prefers your template that's fine but our legal team will review.
- BYOK: For our initial pilot, Redwood-managed keys are acceptable, but we may require BYOK for production later. Please confirm whether BYOK is supported and a high-level timeline to enable it.
- Timeline: we'd like the SIG/CAIQ returned in ~5 business days and a signed BAA in ~2 weeks to stay on track for an April pilot.

We also created a ticket in our vendor portal and can push the CAIQ there — URL below. I can also start a DocuSign envelope for the BAA once we have the right template.

On another note — can you confirm whether Redwood maintains a list of subprocessors and whether you provide a deletion SLA for customer data?

Thanks,
Jane Miller
Head of Vendor Risk & Compliance | Nimbus Health

Related link: https://vendor-portal.nimbushealth.com/portal/requests/CAIQ-6789

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps on security questionnaire (HIPAA/GDPR)

Hi Jane — thanks for the fast reply and clear timeline. Looping in Vivek (security engineering) and Monica (legal/commercial support) to help with the detailed items below.

- PHI handling: noted that PDFs and documents are in-scope. We'll mark the appropriate controls in the SIG/CAIQ accordingly.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for our inference platform covering security and availability (2025 reporting period). I'm attaching a short summary; Vivek can provide redacted report excerpts under NDA.
- BAA: Redwood is willing to sign a standard BAA as a vendor. Monica — can you confirm next steps on our side for counter-signing Nimbus's template?
- BYOK: We support BYOK for data at rest via KMS integrations (AWS KMS customer keys / external HSM via KMIP for private deployments). For hosted pilot, using Redwood-managed keys is typical; enabling BYOK for production usually takes 2–4 weeks depending on contract and key provisioning.
- Subprocessors: we publish a current list on our vendor portal and include it in the questionnaire responses. We also provide a 30-day notice for new subprocessors; we can mark the specific list in the CAIQ.
- Deletion SLA: Standard deletion within 30 days after contract termination; we can discuss accelerated options if Nimbus requires (e.g., 7-day SLA with contractual addendum).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf; redwood-mfa-arch.png

If it's helpful, Vivek and I are available for a short technical dive this week to walk through encryption and key options.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps on security questionnaire (HIPAA/GDPR)

Dylan / Vivek / Monica — thanks for the answers and attachments. A couple follow-ups before we push this to our pilot team: 

1) DocuSign: I'll open a DocuSign for the CAIQ acceptance and a separate envelope for the BAA (Nimbus legal prefers our template). Expect those links by EOD.
2) BYOK detail: can Vivek provide a one-page note that covers supported KMS providers, expected integration steps for our infra team, and any limitations for hosted vs private deployment? That will help our cloud ops assess effort.
3) Subprocessors: please attach or paste the current subprocessors list in the CAIQ. We need to review any analytics/telemetry vendors separately.
4) Encryption: one clarifying item from our security team — do you support customer-managed keys with envelope encryption (i.e., customer root KMS + Redwood-managed data keys), or do you only offer direct KMS key usage?
5) Deletion SLA: pilot team prefers 7-day deletion; are you open to a short addendum for that scope?

Proposed immediate timeline: CAIQ completed in 3 business days (we'll accept pre-filled CSV), DocuSign BAA in 10 business days. Can you confirm?

Thanks — Jane
Head of Vendor Risk & Compliance | Nimbus Health
